resources.string: Disconnected shell · No account · No network · No message storage
This build validates Messenger client structure and communication provenance only. Messaging, calling, Identity sessions, key establishment, and end-to-end encryption are not active.
The client evaluates Identity, conversation authorization, GoreeCloud Data transport, and E2EE as separate prerequisites. Missing or unknown evidence fails closed.
Examples demonstrate how the client must label actual transport and verified protection. They are not live conversations or service state.

Release qualification still requires accepted GoreeCloud Identity, Wardveil Security, Privacy Shield, Everkeep, Mesh, Manager, GoreeCloud Policy, GoreeCloud Observability, current Glaze UI application acceptance, representative-device accessibility, recovery, signing, and release evidence.
Open Messenger help, startup guide, and contextual hint controls
There is no live account, network transport, message storage, composer, or Send action in this build. The visible screens demonstrate client structure and communication provenance only.
Secure messaging must earn its authority

Identity, exact conversation authorization, GoreeCloud Data transport, and exact-conversation E2EE are separate prerequisites. Missing or unknown evidence fails closed instead of being presented as ready.

This Android Development artifact requests no Internet, contacts, SMS, phone, microphone, or camera permission and keeps Android backup disabled. Transport and protection labels are examples until live capabilities are separately implemented and accepted.
Replay the startup guide at any time or turn contextual hints on or off globally. These controls do not activate Identity, messaging, networking, storage, E2EE, or calling.
Tip: Data send remains unavailable until Identity, conversation authorization, Data transport, and E2EE are independently accepted.
